$description: Token proposals for SessionSwitcher (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon covers it another way. Values are aliases to Carbon's own tokens where one exists.

menu-hover.$description: A hovered row. The state ladder is counted in surface steps toward contrast from the token a control rests on: hover is one step, selected two. A row rests on the menu surface, so its hover is the blue-gray one step in — the same family as the selected tint, one rung below it, which is what keeps the two readable as the same ladder rather than two unrelated greys. Falls back to $layer-hover. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

menu-selected.$description: A selected row in the session menu. Carbon's Menu marks selection with a checkmark only and has no selected fill, so this adds the blue-gray tint at the selected step. The value is deliberately identical to chat-input-menu-selected and mega-button-selected-fill: one rule — what selected looks like — declared a third time because Carbon has no token for it and a proposal is component-scoped. At graduation the three collapse into one Carbon token. Falls back to $layer-selected. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

menu-selected-text.$description: The label of a selected session row: the brand blue solved for contrast on session-switcher-menu-selected. Identical to chat-input-menu-selected-text and mega-button-selected-text, for the same reason. Falls back to $text-primary. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

menu-active.$description: A row being pressed in the session menu: the active rung on the blue-gray ladder, three steps from the menu surface and one past selected. Identical to chat-input-menu-active, for the same reason menu-selected matches chat-input-menu-selected: the same menu in the same shell. At graduation the two collapse into one Carbon token. Falls back to $layer-active. Resolved from the shared menu-active-fill, not picked by hand.
